subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers pursue real Control UI browser/gateway proof and a current-module port for this watchdog branch, or waive/pause the proof gate?
rationale: The code direction is bounded, but the remaining gate is not a mechanical line-level bug: maintainers must decide whether to spend proof/porting effort, override proof, or pause the replacement branch.

options.title: Prove and port the watchdog
options.body: Port the fix to `ui/src/pages/chat`, refresh the dirty branch, and attach redacted browser/gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Override proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can waive real behavior proof if they are comfortable landing timer-driven chat recovery based on source and tests only.

options.title: Pause or close this replacement
options.body: If the current watchdog branch is not worth porting, keep the canonical issue open for a fresh implementation path.

recommendation.title: Prove and port the watchdog
recommendation.body: Port the fix to `ui/src/pages/chat`, refresh the dirty branch, and attach redacted browser/gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main chat-surface work makes this the best available routing owner for deciding whether to port the branch into the split UI modules.
